source._version_note: v4.15.3 is the LATEST zitadel GA (gh api repos/zitadel/zitadel/releases/latest => v4.15.3, published 2026-06-22; commit e2886a61670ca8fd41c9434f87036546e5620bcc). go.mod directive is `go 1.25.0` / `toolchain go1.25.8`; the builder is golang:1.26-bookworm with GOTOOLCHAIN=local (set by render_l009_kit) so the current 1.26 toolchain compiles, never the stale go.mod-pinned go1.25.8 — building against the newer Go stdlib is the dominant stale-stdlib-in-binary CVE remediation. ldflags version var is github.com/zitadel/zitadel/cmd/build.version (default 'dev'); the offline stage MUST stamp -X .../cmd/build.version=v4.15.3 explicitly (the --depth-1 vendored tree has no git tag for build.go to derive from).

vendor_build._note: GENERATED-embed materialization driven by the upstream nx project graph (there is NO top-level Makefile). Runs ONLINE in the vendor stage so all the network this needs is allowed: pnpm registry (workspace deps incl. nx/buf/sass/angular), `buf generate` -> buf.build BSR (3 proto deps pinned in proto/buf.lock: grpc-gateway, protoc-gen-validate, googleapis), and console/scripts/install-proto-plugins.sh -> 3 GitHub release binaries (protoc-gen-grpc-web 1.5.0, protoc-gen-js 4.0.2, protoc-gen-openapiv2 2.22.0; sha256-verified in the script). Ordered exactly as nx resolves: (1) pnpm install; (2) generate-install = 14 codegen tools into .artifacts/bin/linux/amd64 (gci/enumer/mockgen/stringer are go:generate-only and not needed for the binary build, so only the 10 proto/statik tools are installed — verified sufficient live); (3) generate-stubs = `buf generate` then copy .artifacts/grpc/.../pkg/grpc -> pkg/grpc + openapi; (4) generate-assets = asset_generator.go -> internal/api/assets authz.go/router.go; (5) generate-statik = login SCSS (`pnpm sass` via go:generate) + 4 statik embeds; (6) console:install-proto-plugins + console:generate (`pnpm exec buf generate ../proto --include-imports --include-wkt` -> console/src/app/proto/generated) + console:build (Angular `ng build`, the longest+heaviest step) then build-console = wipe internal/api/ui/console/static and copy console/dist/console/* in. PATH must front .artifacts/bin/linux/amd64 so buf and the protoc-gen-* plugins resolve (set in cmd[0] and re-exported because render joins with && in ONE container, preserving the export). GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false on the go installs. After this, render_l009_kit runs `go get <dep_bumps> && go mod tidy -e && go mod vendor`; the generated pkg/grpc + statik.go + console static are main-module source files, so they survive vendoring and the offline `go build .` compiles cleanly instead of failing with the gitignored-generated-source errors. nodejs in tooling triggers the nodesource setup_22.x install + corepack in render_l009_kit's vendor apt block; node_version 22 == .nvmrc lts/jod since v4.19.5 (upstream commit 2269419, 2026-10-09: lts/iron (20, end of life) -> lts/jod to match its CI, which builds with Node 22, and testcontainers 12 in the login's dev dependencies needs Node >= 22.22; v4.19.3 and earlier were authored and verified on Node 20); pnpm@10.30.3 comes via corepack (packageManager field). Do NOT add `make`/`pnpm`/`corepack` to tooling beyond nodejs — render already apt-installs git/ca-certs/curl/gnupg/make and node+corepack from the nodejs marker.

binaries_from_source._note: Single static binary. main_pkg is the repo ROOT '.' (main.go -> cmd.Execute). The version var is github.com/zitadel/zitadel/cmd/build.version (cmd/build/build.go, default 'dev'); a plain `go build` without -X reports 'dev', so the offline stage stamps -X .../cmd/build.version=v4.15.3 explicitly here (the upstream pack-platform also stamps cmd/build.commit + cmd/build.date from git, but those derive from git history the --depth-1 vendored tree lacks, so we ship only the version stamp — `zitadel --version` prints the version line). CGO_ENABLED=0 yields a fully static ELF ideal for the --network=none offline / non-root model. No build tags.
